responsibility: This header publishes low-level RTL expansion helpers for address manipulation, register forcing, promotion, stack adjustment, probing, stack save/restore, dynamic stack allocation, address alignment, and function/libcall return-value queries. It is the public interface to explow.cc used by higher-level expander code when it needs semantically aware stack and address operations rather than raw RTL building.
same_name_distinction: Header interface in the `explow` group: it declares the address, stack, promotion, and libcall-return helpers consumed by higher-level expander code, whereas `gcc/explow.cc` implements them.
